verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source Python crawling library that offers browser-automation primitives: Chromium/Firefox/WebKit support, hooks for fine-grained browser control, JS execution and CDP remote browser connection. However, the evidence never names Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or Scrapy, either as its underlying engine or as an integration, so the fit with this story is only inferred. Missing for 10: explicit documented support for or integration with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or Scrapy; examples of using those libraries alongside Crawl4AI; independent corroboration.
